_comment: Silver set: 7 filings beyond the 3 hand-validated gold. Ground truth is programmatic (count items found, era-applicable status distribution, edgartools agreement) rather than hand-validated. Used to detect regressions and surface failure modes that gold is too narrow to catch.

filings.characteristic: Conglomerate, latest filing year. Berkshire incorporates Part III (Items 10-14) entirely by reference to the Proxy Statement WITHOUT per-item body sections; the only mention of Items 10-14 is in the TOC. edgartools (and our regex) won't find Part III items because there's nothing to find. Honest finding: modern 10-Ks vary in how they declare by-ref; we recover Items 1, 1A-1C, 2-9C, and 15.

Item 1C voluntary-disclosure case: FY2023 ended 2023-09-30, before mandatory 1C effective date 2023-12-15. Apple disclosed Item 1C voluntarily, so 1C SHOULD appear (originally we expected it to be absent, but the filing shows otherwise; informative finding).

Part III only amendment. Filing is small (25K chars total) and contains only Item 15 as a per-item heading; Part III items (10-14) are incorporated by reference WITHOUT in-line declarations in the amendment. edgartools' 'All detection strategies failed' warning surfaces, and our regex finds only Item 15. Honest finding: 10-K/A amendments often have minimal content with by-reference Part III, so extracting that requires either manual parsing of the by-ref boilerplate or LLM augmentation.
